name: Zacharias Zechariah
overview: Zacharias, also known as Zechariah, was a priest during the time of King Herod and the father of John the Baptist, as noted in Luke 1:5 and Luke 3:2. He is remembered both for his righteous service and for being murdered by the Jewish people between the temple and the altar, a fact Jesus references in Matthew 23:35 and Luke 11:51 to underscore the gravity of rejecting God's messengers. His life and death serve as a solemn reminder of the cost of faithfulness and the fulfillment of God's redemptive plan through John the Baptist.
